steps.app: Larkfield (Infra clock and events, then GUI Refresh)
steps.action: Infra moves the clock to 1 December 09:00, past the reviews of cl-15, cl-16 and cl-17 and the expiry of cl-13's questions already scheduled in the fixture, and applies the proposal's example events ev-1 (claim.received cl-7) and ev-2 (pa.submitted pa-4 for Riley); Refresh; Prior authorizations → pa-4
steps.expected: pa-4 pending with its decision due; explanation-of-benefits, information-request, claim-denied and decision-overdue entries in Larkfield's log

steps.action: Infra applies ev-3 (pa.info_requested) and ev-4 (pa.info_provided) and moves the clock to 3 December 11:30; Refresh; pa-4 → reason → Ask for expedited review
steps.expected: The expedite request is recorded with its reason

steps.action: Infra applies ev-5 (expedite approved) and pa.decided denying pa-4; Refresh; pa-4 → statement → Preview appeal; Infra applies user.confirmed by Jordan; Refresh; Confirm
steps.expected: pa-4 denied; the appeal on it filed from the page, with its decision due

steps.app: Larkfield (Infra events and clock, then GUI Refresh)
steps.action: Infra applies ev-8 (appeal.info_requested on ap-3), moves the clock to 3 April 2027, past the closing notice of cl-14's appeal window, and applies appeal.decided overturning ap-3 on 5 April; Refresh; Appeals → ap-3
steps.expected: ap-3 overturned; entries of all 9 notice kinds in Larkfield's log, waiting for the sender

infra: appeal.decided ap-3 overturned (ev-9, at 5 April 2027) committed

steps.app: Messaging and Mail (Infra runs the sender; Mail GUI)
steps.action: Infra runs infra/sender.cjs: one Router session per recipient Mail account (mail-m-1 for Jordan, mail-m-2 for Casey), each with its grant from infra/router.config.example.json; then Jordan's Mail inbox is opened on Mail's own Web Host page
steps.expected: Every entry whose recipient may still see the member delivered to that person's Mail account with a committed receipt; entries for Riley, a minor without a Mail account (no_mail_account), and entries whose recipient lost access to the member before the sender ran (access_changed: Casey's act grant for Jordan's records ended on 1 January 2027) stay in Larkfield's log; Larkfield's state unchanged by publishing

steps.action: Open the “Appeal received” message in Mail; read it through Mail's Agent tool mail.get
steps.expected: The notice text as Larkfield wrote it, from the Larkfield sender address to mail-m-1

observed.subject: Appeal received
observed.body: Appeal ap-4 of prior authorization pa-4 for member m-3 was received; a decision is due by 2027-01-03 at 23:59 Eastern Time.

steps.action: Open the “Appeal window closing” message in Mail; read it through Mail's Agent tool mail.get
steps.expected: The notice text as Larkfield wrote it, from the Larkfield sender address to mail-m-1

observed.subject: Appeal window closing
observed.body: The appeal window for claim cl-14 (member m-3) closes on 2027-04-16 at 23:59 Eastern Time.

stages.business_confirmation: Not claimed. A committed Mail record shows delivery into the recipient's Mail account, not that the person read or acted on it.

refusal.condition: The Router session for mail-m-1 is configured without the grant for that account (allowed_recipients empty); mail-m-2 keeps its grant
refusal.action: Infra applies appeal.info_requested on Riley's appeal ap-3, which writes an entry for each guardian, Jordan (m-1) and Casey (m-2), and for Riley (m-3); Infra aligns the Mail clocks to Larkfield's (adapter.align), records both Apps' state, and runs the sender once
